name: Raven Black Luck Life ~Haishuku no Aruji ni Natte Wakeari Hime to Sister to Sugosu Yadoya Life~
original_name: レイブン・ブラック・ラック・ライフ ～廃宿の主になってワケアリ姫とシスターと過ごす宿屋ライフ～
source:
The protagonist, Aruji, is a knight belonging to the guild "Pisolino Corvo" (The Raven's Nap). The guild operates like a jack-of-all-trades, taking on any and all jobs regardless of the particulars. Among their more principled peers, they're derided as the unprincipled "Ravens of the Dumpheap." For this reason, the guild is full of characters with more than a few quirks - those who were dismissed from the Royal Knights, those who were expelled from other guilds, and the like.

At the request of the guild, Aruji is sent to work as the proprietor of an abandoned inn in the Kingdom of Valleroy. Being a jack-of-all-trades, his primary profession as a knight was irrelevant; such requests were by no means uncommon.

From past experience, Aruji knows that such a request from the guild means that there must be something fishy about this case. Whether it's the inn itself, or the future patrons, or even both that are fishy, Aruji would have to find out on his own...

Upon arriving at the inn, Aruji immediately stumbles upon the reason. The long-abandoned inn is covered in dust and cobwebs, making it look like a ruin. An abandoned inn where no one should be - yet there are clear signs that someone lives there.

Aruji explores the inn with increased vigilance, and comes across a girl carrying a sword...

[Translated from the [url=https://kelpy.net/index02/story.php]official website[/url]]
translation:
主角阿鲁吉是公会“Pisolino Corvo”（The Raven's Nap）所属的骑士。该行会的运作方式就像一个万事通，无论具体情况如何，都能承担任何工作。在更有原则的同龄人中，他们被嘲笑为没有原则的“垃圾场乌鸦”。正因如此，公会里充满了不少怪癖人物——被皇家骑士开除的人、被其他公会开除的人等等。

应公会的要求，阿鲁吉被派往瓦勒罗伊王国的一家废弃旅馆担任老板。作为一个多才多艺的人，他的主要职业是骑士，这与他无关。此类要求绝非罕见。

根据以往的经验，阿鲁吉知道，公会提出这样的要求，就说明这件事一定有猫腻。无论是旅馆本身，还是未来的顾客，甚至两者都有可疑之处，都需要阿鲁吉自己去发现……

到达旅馆后，阿鲁吉立刻就明白了原因。这座废弃已久的客栈布满了灰尘和蜘蛛网，看起来就像一片废墟。一座废弃的旅馆，没人应该呆在那里——但有明显的迹象表明有人住在那里。

阿鲁吉提高警惕地探索旅馆，遇到了一名拿着剑的女孩……

[翻译自[url=https://kelpy.net/index02/story.php]官网[/url]]
